title: dep-scan vdb download output
description: The document `depscan vdb download --format json` writes on stdout after the download completed and the marker was written: the image reference and the marker written for a complete flavor, or the refreshed shard names and the shard-set marker for --shards. A download that fails produces the error document instead of this one.

image.description: The image reference that was downloaded.

marker.description: The image reference recorded in the download marker, as `depscan vdb info` reports it.

shards.description: The canonical shard names that were refreshed, in the order they were requested.

marker.description: The shard-set marker written for this refresh, as `depscan vdb info` reports it.
